both_blur.wiener_kernel: each image restored with its own exact generation kernel, balance = base selected value for that blur id
both_blur.rationale: Motion length 17 px was chosen because it is the base condition with the largest single-sided blur effect (choice made after seeing base Test results -> exploratory). 'diff' uses the orthogonal direction at the same length, the most distinct kernel available among the base conditions.

timing_scope: runtime_ms = processing of both images (Unsharp/Wiener CPU in-process; NAFNet GPU t_total_ms from the manifest) + detectAndCompute on both images + match + homography. Feature times are measured at first computation (images shared between rows are computed once).
